# The All-Hours Route

*A few routes Perch's birds refuse at every hour, and all of them cross the Ram Hills. Clear the rams and howlers along the route and bring back the great feathers the rams carry in their fleece.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Urbanograd](../towns/urbanograd_quests.md) |
| Category | Story |
| Given by | [Perch](../npcs/perch.md) |
| Level | 60 |
| After | [The Beacon Ruins](../quests/lux_the_beacon_ruins.md) |
| Leads to | [Across the Crest](../quests/perch_across_the_crest.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Millstone Ram](../monsters/millstone_ram.md) in [Ram Hills](../maps/ram_hills.md)
- Defeat 30 [Downs Howler](../monsters/downs_wolf.md) in [Ram Hills](../maps/ram_hills.md)
- Bring 3 [Great Grey Feather](../items/stormcrest_feather.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 226,860 EXP
- 10,200 mesos
- +60 standing with [Perch](../npcs/perch.md)
- +20 standing with Urbanograd
